# Stage 05-raise: Raise

[← 04-launch](./04-launch.md) · [all stages](./README.md) · [06-operate →](./06-operate.md)

**Purpose.** Research investors, build the deck and data room, run outreach and manage a fundraising process.

**Exit gate.** A funded round closed, or a documented decision to bootstrap instead.
